title: My agents stopped sending me docs and started sending me HTML
description: My agents stopped sending me docs and started sending me HTML, and it changed how I work with them. Instead of a markdown file or a DocX, every research report and every analytics run comes back as a beautifully formatted interactive page I open right in my browser, charts, graphs, the whole thing, no server needed but it feels like a real website. I just took a bunch of flights and my agents generated me a full HTML UI to compare flight times with my friends, see my layovers, and what I had to do between each stop. Agents using HTML as a generative UI is the upgrade nobody talks about. I run all of it through cortextOS, Claude Code and Codex from my phone over Telegram. Link in bio.
